蚂蚁为什么排着队走？: Why do ants walk in a line?
地上有一条我们看不见的气味小路。试着擦掉一小段，再帮侦察蚁找到绕行路线。: There is an invisible scent trail on the ground. Wipe away a small part, then help a scout find a way around.
把“显示气味”关掉：蚂蚁还能跟着走吗？气味看不见，不等于不存在。: Turn off “Show scent”. Can the ants still follow it? Invisible does not mean absent.
展示部分蚂蚁利用踪迹信息素招募觅食伙伴的机制，并非所有蚂蚁都用同一种方式。紫色点: This shows trail-pheromone recruitment used by some ants; not all ants forage in the same way. Purple dots are not visible in nature. Routes, speeds, the paused search and the detour are teaching steps, not a colony prediction model. A new trail does not appear from nowhere: the button represents a scout having searched and left a new cue. Observe wild ants without erasing trails or putting out food.
先猜一猜，再动手试一试。: Make a guess, then try it.
一些蚂蚁找到食物后会留下气味痕迹。伙伴用触角探测气味，沿着路线前进。紫色点只是帮: Some ants leave scent trails after finding food. Other ants detect the scent with their antennae and follow it. Purple dots help us visualize the scent.
咦，气味小路断了: The scent trail has a gap
失去气味线索时，蚂蚁可能在附近寻找。这里把寻找过程停下来，让你看清缺口。: Without the scent clue, ants may search nearby. We pause that search here so you can see the gap.
侦察蚁找到食物后，沿着新路线留下气味。伙伴可能逐渐跟上新路线。: After finding food, a scout leaves scent on a new route. Other ants may gradually follow it.
画面暂时停住，方便你找到气味缺口。这不是每只蚂蚁真实停下的位置；失去线索的蚂蚁可: The picture is paused so you can locate the scent gap. These are not measured stopping positions; ants that lose the cue may continue searching nearby.
这是找到新线索后的一种路线对照，蚂蚁位置已经重新安排。按前进，观察伙伴怎样沿新路: This compares one possible new route, with the ants repositioned for the illustration. Press walk to follow the new trail; the change between pictures is not the actual search.
